title: 第五章 徒儿们第六章 为人师表
slug: 穿进男频爽文反派师尊科学修仙
lines: ‘那必不可能！’解清玄在脑子里一拍大腿。
至少她今日已速成了御剑之术！她还没玩够（不是）！
她可以御剑带着这孩子在山间找一找！
解清玄再次伸出手，对段莫弃直言：“需要我带你去找个洞府吗？”
在段莫弃面前她其实不需要太过严格地维持原主的人设。他今日方才进内门，对她所知应当全来自于传言。
而且解清玄维持原主人设也只是不想引起流云宗内其他人的注意。她怕的不是暴露“自己不是原主”这件事，面对这个世界的所有人，她最不想暴露，也最不能暴露的，自始至终只有一件事，那就是“她是个脑子空空没能力自保的修仙文盲”。
男频爽文里，实力至上，如果她能有个化神修为，那就算是明目张胆的告诉全宗门“我就是夺舍了这位源述长老”，也没人敢说一个“不”字。
段莫弃这次并没有接受解清玄的好意，他恭敬作揖行礼，挂着客气尊重的浅笑：“弟子怎敢再麻烦师尊，今日天色已晚，弟子明日在这山上慢慢去寻个洞府就好。”
他很清楚自己该去哪里。
‘这孩子，怎么这时候跟她客气起来了？’解清玄也不甚在意，既然他不愿意，那自己也乐得省事。
“你也不必与我客气，若是累了今日便去休息，若是一时半会儿找不到合适的洞府就再来问我。”这事拖一拖也好，她可以趁着今晚自己先在山头周围探一探地图。
谁成想，段莫弃若有所思地点点头，然后突然就改了口。
“师尊山上的洞府有很多吗？”他稍微有些不好意思地请求着：“若是如此，那徒儿确实需要麻烦师尊帮忙了……”
‘嗯？’解清玄也没多想，再次横好飞剑，招呼段莫弃拉住她的手：“如此，那就速去速回。”
解清玄记得原著中略微提过这样么一嘴，说灵桓峰东南侧的洞府灵气较为充裕，于是她便带着段莫弃直接绕去山峰东南。
乍一看去，这一面山峰石壁上有大小三个洞府开口。解清玄觉得可能越靠近峰顶的洞府灵气越充裕，便直接带着段莫弃落在了最上方一个洞府前的小片草地上。
她稍稍往洞里看了看，见里面没有人类活动的痕迹，便迈脚往洞里进。
“师尊……”身后段莫弃似乎想说些什么。
“何事？”解清玄微微侧头回应，脚下却没停，一步跨进了洞口。
她顿时觉得自己好像撞碎了什么看不见的东西……
“没事了……”段莫弃面色平淡地跟在解清玄身后也进了洞。
“嗯？”解清玄只听得洞里传来一声疑惑轻哼，随后便是急匆匆向洞口赶来的脚步声。
“师……师尊？”一位看起来三十出头、长相忠厚的中年人满面惊愕地跑至解清玄面前，站定后赶紧鞠躬行礼，他声音疑惑，还带这些小心翼翼：“您这是……有什么要事吩咐徒儿吗？”
‘这尊大佛什么时候出的关？’林坚完全没想到师尊会突然来他的洞府，还一言不合就毁了他的护洞阵法！
解清玄顿时汗流浃背。她也知道自己应该是不小心弄坏了什么东西。
她还未习惯使用自己多出来的那个“器官”，也就是“灵根”，所以她对灵气这种东西十分的不敏感，并未察觉这里设有结界，屏蔽了内里声音与光线，便也没想到这里住着人。
content_en:
‘That must be impossible! ’ Xie Qingxuan slapped his thigh in his mind.
At least she has quickly mastered the art of sword control today! She hasn't had enough (no)!
She can use her sword to take this child to search in the mountains!
Jie Qingxuan stretched out his hand again and said bluntly to Duan Moqi: "Do you need me to take you to find a cave?"
In front of Duan Moqi, she didn't need to strictly maintain the character of the original owner. He had just entered the inner gate today, and all he knew about her should have come from rumors.
Moreover, Jie Qingxuan maintained the original character just because he did not want to attract the attention of other people in Liuyun Sect. What she is afraid of is not the exposure that "she is not the original owner". Facing everyone in this world, the thing she least wants to expose and cannot be exposed is the only thing from beginning to end, that is, "she is an illiterate cultivator with an empty mind and no ability to protect herself."
In Nanpinshuang's article, strength is paramount. If she could achieve the cultivation of becoming a god, no one would dare to say "no" even if she blatantly told the whole sect, "I just took away the body of Elder Yuanshu."
Duan Moqi did not accept Xie Qingxuan's kindness this time. He bowed respectfully and said with a polite and respectful smile: "How dare I trouble the master again? It's getting late today. I can just go slowly and find a cave in this mountain tomorrow."
He knew exactly where he was going.
‘Why is this kid so polite to her now? ’ Xie Qingxuan didn’t care much. Since he didn’t want to, he was happy to save the trouble.
"You don't have to be polite to me. If you're tired, go and rest today. If you can't find a suitable cave for a while, come back and ask me." It's better to postpone this matter. She can take advantage of tonight to explore the map around the mountain.
Unexpectedly, Duan Moqi nodded thoughtfully, and then suddenly changed his mind.
"Are there many caves on Master's mountain?" He asked with a little embarrassment: "If so, then I really need to ask Master for help..."
‘Huh? ’ Xie Qingxuan didn’t think much, he raised the flying sword again, and called Duan Moqi to hold her hand: “In that case, let’s go and come back quickly.”
Xie Qingxuan remembered that the original book mentioned something like this, saying that the caves on the southeast side of Linghuan Peak had abundant spiritual energy, so she took Duan Moqi directly to the southeast of the peak.
At first glance, there are three large and small cave openings on the stone wall of this mountain peak. Xie Qingxuan felt that the caves closer to the peak might have more spiritual energy, so he took Duan Mo Qi directly to the small patch of grass in front of the top cave.
She looked slightly into the cave and saw that there were no traces of human activity inside, so she stepped into the cave.
"Master..." Duan Moqi seemed to want to say something behind him.
"What's the matter?" Jie Qingxuan responded with a slight tilt of his head, but without stopping, he stepped into the cave entrance.
She suddenly felt as if she had smashed something invisible...
"It's okay..." Duan Moqi followed Xie Qingxuan into the cave with a calm expression.
"Huh?" Xie Qingxuan only heard a confused hum from the cave, followed by the sound of footsteps rushing towards the entrance of the cave.
"Master... Master?" A middle-aged man who looked like he was in his early thirties and had a loyal appearance ran up to Jie Qingxuan with a face full of surprise. After standing still, he quickly bowed and saluted. His voice was confused and cautious: "You... do you have anything important to tell my disciple?"
‘When did this giant Buddha come out of seclusion? ’ Lin Jian didn’t expect that Master would suddenly come to his cave and destroy his cave-protecting formation even after a disagreement!
Xie Qingxuan was suddenly sweating profusely. She also knew that she might have accidentally broken something.
She was not used to using her extra "organ", that is, the "spiritual root", so she was very insensitive to things like spiritual energy. She did not realize that there was a barrier here, blocking the sound and light inside, and she did not expect that there were people living here.
